cases.customer_question: What documents and preparation steps are required to complete Bluetooth SIG product registration and compliance folder creation?
question_variants: What documents are needed for Bluetooth SIG registration?
What is required for the compliance folder?
What information must be submitted before Bluetooth qualification listing?
What materials are needed for delegated Bluetooth registration?
What supporting documents are required for audit compliance?
cases.actual_issue: Understanding the required procedural steps, payment timing, and documentation needed for Bluetooth SIG listing and compliance folder preparation.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth qualification requires both online registration work and supporting technical records. The company must complete payment processing and provide product documentation proving how Bluetooth is implemented. These records must also be retained for future SIG audits.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant instructed the customer to identify the module's Link Layer and Host Stack registrations from the module datasheet, complete the quotation/request forms, and complete Qualification Fee payment before the target registration date. The consultant explained that the compliance folder must include the Bluetooth-related operation manual, block diagram, external drawing, and antenna documentation including radiation gain characteristics. The consultant also noted that the compliance folder must be retained until one year after product sales end and may be requested during SIG audits.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth qualification requires payment confirmation, accurate design referencing, and maintenance of supporting compliance evidence. Compliance folders are mandatory audit records tied to the qualified product.
cases.final_recommendation: Prepare the required qualification forms, complete Qualification Fee payment before the desired registration date, and assemble the compliance folder documents including Bluetooth manual sections, block diagrams, product drawings, and antenna specifications.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Missing documentation or delayed payment can postpone qualification completion. Incomplete compliance folders can create audit exposure and inability to demonstrate qualification compliance.
